evidence.text: What functions must work when our network drops?
Core mission alerts must operate without connectivity.
All mission decision processing must happen in the cloud only.
We could cache local data for two days on the edge device.
Mission alerts must be computed onboard while disconnected, without a cloud round trip.
Does the cloud-only policy include safety-critical mission alerts?
Advanced analytics can wait for cloud connectivity, but mission alerts may operate at the edge.
When the connection returns we need to synchronize locally buffered records to the cloud.
Offline authentication must continue to enforce operator roles.
All locally stored sensitive data must be encrypted at rest.
What acceptance test will confirm that offline mission alerts work?
The integration team should demonstrate failover and verify that alerts remain available offline.
